newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo seen fueling US stocks ahead at open.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo seen fueling US stocks ahead at open.

text.p: The Dow Industrials are expected to move higher in early trading, following through on a late attempt Wednesday by the average to recoup losses after taking a pounding from a sell-off in IBM Corp shares.
Analysts said PepsiCo Inc would rally strongly Thursday on press reports that it was on the verge of spinning off its $11 billion restaurant business, fueling blue chips.
"If you look at yesterday, you see that when we ended we were coming back. The breadth was even keel," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
